How Many Movers Do I Need?

How to estimate the number of movers for a job.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

The right crew size depends on home size, stairs, distance, and how fast you need the move finished.
